notes.title: Major updates
notes.content:
New features added
1. Now you can add descriptive text to the item to describe it.
You can add descriptive information to objects by selecting them through character backpacks, plant warehouses, and cross map warehouses.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790366/82971acb4d1a28f99fa344e146c0c12537e7e068.gif[/img]
Character backpack

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790366/9356e4c970be1d5fdfd4f18a7fdb8813b67ac10b.gif[/img]
Plant warehouse

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790366/90388a155885b946025cfca04f5ac2303a389afd.gif[/img]
Cross map warehouse
2. The character will now make footsteps while walking. Now the character will make footsteps while moving.
3. It is now possible to export and import archives. The exported archive has two files, one ". xj" file is the archive data, and the other ". xj. png" is a preview of the archive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790366/6ec00a6d646b01798434258f09b57595e89665c0.gif[/img]
export

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790366/4ab4b4a56545d50b65871451803e9689742bcae2.gif[/img]
Import

optimization
After setting up the sunlight, the direction of the sunlight will be recorded when exiting the save. The next time entering the archive, the previously set direction of sunlight will be used.
2. The items in the character's backpack will be sorted in reverse order, and the latest object added to the backpack will be placed in the first grid.

Fix the issue
1. Fix the issue where other objects cannot be selected after adding candles and torches to the scene.
2. Fix the issue of ineffective random rotation and scaling when plants are part of a combination.
3. To avoid the problem of game crashes when loading oversized objects in the item editor, it is now necessary to manually load objects in the item editor instead of automatically loading them.

notes.title: Day and night changes, optimized sloping appearance, and optimized performance
notes.content:
1. Two interactive objects have been added to the earth map.
An object can purchase torches and candles from it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790366/6d70f49086cf77fcf9574948e5ce6001aaef59f6.gif[/img]
An object can change the day and night of a map. Clicking on the black antenna will change the map from day to night, and clicking on the white antenna will change the map from night to day.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790366/5ece485b82d6f231300f1133fc90fdd531892ca8.gif[/img]
2. Optimized the appearance of the sloping surface, making it more natural.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790366/529b2d1808a7d8672d559cb482806f6ab7be407b.png[/img]
3. Optimized performance.
It is faster to load a super large scene (with over 500000 blocks in the scene).
When adding and deleting oversized objects, the game response is not as sluggish.
If the deleted object consists of more than 512 blocks, there will be an excessive animation of demolition.
If the added object consists of more than 10240 blocks, a demolished add animation will appear.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790366/90a22657a600f801d8f00037b1e46082c51932b1.gif[/img]
Happy Lunar New Year to all players! .^_^.
